source_review.definition: Minimize the integer diameter max(A)-min(A) of a k-element admissible set. For each prime p<=k the residue set must omit at least one residue, and p>k is automatic by cardinality. Add k1000 and3000 alongside k343.
source_review.primary_source: Sol personally downloaded the MIT official tuple texts admissible_1000_7802.txt and admissible_3000_26606.txt, matched exact bytes to archives and JSON points in order. MathBases July14-2026 inventory marks proven cases; MIT accepted.log archived rows credit Engelsma and xfxie in 2013 and record the respective upper bounds7802/26606, with no optimal marker. For3000, older26622 row also marked current at submission, so choose smallest current recorded bound26606.
source_review.independent_method: Sol personally ran all human and fixed-reference programs. Independent trial-division enumeration of every prime <=k, exact residue sets and missing classes, sorted distinct cardinality and exact max-min reproduce both records. No published optimality proof found in the checked source scope.
source_review.cold_start: For new k, select first k primes greater than k using a sieve. Each selected integer avoids 0 modulo every p<=k. Finite initial spans8424/28972. A discarded primorial draft made the objective too large for runner normalization; it was replaced without changing the mathematical goal or scoring.
source_review.admission: Five strict programs, independent recomputation, damaged and score-claim cases, exact replay, cold export, errors, nonfinite and timeout all passed. Original k343 archives preserved. New outputs include actual seed and budget metadata.
